summary: Senior software engineer who builds dependable web products and thoughtful developer tools. Experienced across TypeScript, React, and cloud services, with a focus on accessible interfaces, clear technical design, and helping teams deliver maintainable software.

responsibilities: Led a migration of the customer workspace to React and TypeScript, reducing duplicated UI code across product teams.
Designed event-driven services for billing and account workflows, improving reliability during peak traffic.
Partnered with design and product to ship accessible onboarding used by more than 40,000 monthly customers.
Mentored four engineers through project planning, code review, and production incident follow-up.
Built REST and GraphQL endpoints for a logistics planning platform used by regional delivery teams.
Introduced background job monitoring and retry policies, reducing failed shipment updates by 35%.
Created a reusable component library and documentation that accelerated frontend delivery across three teams.
Implemented customer-facing dashboard features with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
Added integration tests around shipment status updates and documented service contracts.
Worked with support to diagnose customer issues and turn recurring reports into product fixes.
Built responsive websites and small business dashboards using JavaScript, CSS, and Node.js.
Improved page performance by optimizing image delivery and removing unused client-side code.
Worked directly with clients to turn design feedback into accessible, maintainable interfaces.

achievements: Recognized with the 2025 Alder Creek Engineering Impact Award.
Spoke about accessible design systems at the fictional Cascadia Product Forum.
Organized a volunteer workshop series introducing web development to career changers.
